mode_inference_decision.rationale: Batch four already identical accepted ground materials without new art.

source.license: Prior accepted original geometry and verified CC0 Poly Haven maps; no new source art.

processing.mesh: Decode all894 vertices, transform POSITION and inverse-transpose NORMAL into ground foundation node space; preserve UV/COLOR and triangle order, offset indices. Keep source nodes25..28 names/TRS, retain node25 mesh; remove three redundant meshes and explicitly remap node mesh indices.
processing.material: Use original material16; require exact semantic equality except names. Keep unused definitions rather than remapping unrelated materials.
processing.preservation: Append attributes/BIN only; preserve original payload prefix and all non-ground geometry/image bytes. 452 ground triangles,75368 total,35 to32 GLB primitives. World position error <=2e-6m, normal angle <=1e-5degrees, UV/COLOR float values exact.
processing.budget: No new texture or shader attribute variant; <50KB file growth. Culling tradeoff: merged ground may process additional vertices when old slab buckets would cull. No FPS claim from primitive count alone.

historical_tool_boundary: V24 is a one-shot process of its preserved original raw source; do not feed the merged V26 structure into patch_ground or overwrite any V24 candidate/evidence.
